_note: Planning requests need no assignment. analyze-ui also takes capture_ref, targets, manifests, image_sinks (names of the project's own picture-loading methods) and layout_helpers (its own layout-parameter builders, one row per arity: call, what each argument gives, and the unit of a bare number - dp, sp or px). validate-ui takes ui_tree_ref/source_index_ref/runtime_index_ref and resource_scope. resource-plan and screen-checks take only args.dimension_analysis_ref ({path, sha256} of the staged analysis): the first returns parameter_sheet_ref, copy_plan_ref and what is left to author (resources outside the plan, undeclared usages, tokens, expressions); the second returns the image checks every picture use still lacks, with rendered references, and text check suggestions.
